name: Electric Super Micro Bubble Beauty Blackhead Remover | Pore Vacuum Cleaner & Facial Deep Cleansing Device | USB Rechargeable Skin Care Tool
description:
Give your skincare routine a deeper cleansing experience with the Electric Super Micro Bubble Beauty Blackhead Remover. Designed with vacuum suction and micro-bubble cleansing technology, this facial beauty device helps remove blackheads, excess oil, and impurities from the skin while providing a refreshing cleansing experience. The device features multiple interchangeable suction tips and adjustable suction levels, allowing you to choose a suitable setting for different areas of the face. Its separate clean-water and dirty-water tanks help keep the water flow separated during use. The compact rechargeable design makes it convenient for regular home skincare and travel.

Key Features
Electric super micro bubble facial cleansing device
Vacuum suction technology for blackhead and pore cleansing
Helps remove blackheads, excess oil, and facial impurities
Micro-bubble function helps cleanse and refresh the skin
Separate clean-water and dirty-water tanks
Multiple suction tips for different facial areas
Adjustable suction levels for customized use
Suitable for nose, forehead, cheeks, and other facial areas
Can be used with water, toner, essence, or suitable skincare solutions
USB rechargeable and portable design
Lightweight ABS body with comfortable grip
Suitable for home skincare and beauty routines

Product Type: Electric Micro Bubble Blackhead Remover

Input Voltage: 5V

Material: ABS
Power Type: Type-C Rechargeable
Water Tank: Separate Clean & Dirty Water Compartments
Usage: Facial Cleansing & Pore Care

How to Use
Clean your face and use a warm towel or gentle steam to prepare the skin
Fill the clean-water tank with suitable water or recommended skincare solution
Select the appropriate suction tip for the area being treated
Start with the lowest suction level, especially for first-time use
Gently move the device continuously across the skin without keeping it in one spot for too long
Use suitable suction levels according to your skin comfort
After use, empty and clean the water tanks and suction tip

Material / Composition
Durable ABS Plastic Body
Interchangeable Facial Suction Tips
Clean Water Tank
Dirty Water Tank
Built-In Rechargeable Battery
Micro Bubble & Vacuum Suction System

Safety Information
Start with the lowest suction setting when using for the first time
Do not keep the device stationary on one area of the skin for an extended period
Avoid using on broken, irritated, or damaged skin
Stop use if excessive redness, pain, or irritation occurs
Clean and dry the device after each use
Use only suitable liquids in the water reservoir
Keep the charging port and electrical components away from water
